title: Blindside
summary: BLINDSIDE, noun [blind and side.] The side which is most easily assailed; or the side on which the party is least able or disposed to see danger; weakness; foible; weak part. BLIND VESSEL, with chimis

inlines.v: BLINDSIDE, noun [blind and side.] The side which is most easily assailed; or the side on which the party is least able or disposed to see danger; weakness; foible; weak part. BLIND VESSEL, with chimists, a vessel with an opening on one side only.
